{{Top|leg}}
'''Recital glasses''' were eyewear used to watch artistic performances. [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]] owned a pair of miniature, delicate recital glasses that were older than the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He used them to watch a performance of [[Dha Werda Verda]].<ref name="SSR">''[[Secrets of the Sisar Run]]''</ref>
